query: SELECT ms.id as setId, ms.name, ms.slug, ms.totalCards FROM marvel_sets ms WHERE ms.slug LIKE '%mint%'; SELECT mc.id, mc.cardNumber, mc.characterName, mc.cardType, mc.imageUrl, mc.back_image_url FROM marvel_cards mc WHERE mc.setId = (SELECT id FROM marvel_sets WHERE slug LIKE '%mint%') AND mc.cardType = 'Base' ORDER BY mc.sortOrder LIMIT 60;
